name: Netherlands
notes: Wide national, supranational and targeted local research in progress; not saturated. R001–R005:203 supporters and244 evidence records. R005 adds14 actors and15 records:12 public Dutch signatories of a G20 wealth-tax letter and2 original policy authors, plus new evidence for Joris Thijssen. International proposals, wealth caps, temporary taxes and conditional designs remain explicit. Letter publication dates are not individual signature timestamps. All evidence verified=n for maintainer review; older runs not fully rechecked. Official CBS2026 map/register:342 municipalities and12 provinces, CC BY4.0; Caribbean public bodies outside map. Local institutional coverage remains preliminary. See area_profile.md and qa_R005.md. Review 2026-10-24 (R006): the exit-tax-only votes were removed; 144 supporters remain.

polls.question: An additional annual wealth tax of 1% on people with net wealth of USD 10 million, to support COVID-19 recovery and people in need.
